_source: OMNIYAT page for The Alba Residences, Dorchester Collection, read 17 September 2026.
_override_note: Hero is the elevation from the water, confirmed by looking. The page's four unit-type galleries are served entirely from files named for OMNIYAT's separate Vela project (vela-palace-*, vela-sky-residence-*), so they cannot be shown to be ALBA interiors and are not registered or used. Two amenity images the developer publishes fall below the size floor and were not upscaled.
image_note: Images are published by OMNIYAT, the developer, on its own project page, and are reproduced here for a buyer considering the building. They are computer renders showing the developer's intended specification — they are not photographs of any particular apartment, and the finish of an individual unit may differ. Ask to view before relying on them.
caveats: OMNIYAT publishes no apartment layouts openly for this building, so none are shown.
